_comment: Mutation testing scoped to the off-engine-testable modules: the pure diffusion-logic modules plus cd-pass.js, the pass orchestrator (added 2026-07-16 once tests/pass.mjs gave it a stub-engine harness). The command runner re-runs the full suite per mutant; coverageAnalysis is off because the command runner has no per-test hooks. The ESM loader (tests/loader.mjs) maps /cultural-diffusion/ to the project root and stubs /core /base-standard, so Stryker's sandbox copy resolves to the mutated sandbox files - no inPlace needed.
